description: Estimate a freelance project from a client message: deliverables found by keyword rules, hours per deliverable, a scope risk buffer and a fixed price (hours times the hourly rate, calculated in integer cents). Runs locally, needs no account and creates nothing. Returns a link to open the same estimate in the TempoRevenue web calculator.

buffer_percent.description: Scope risk buffer in percent. Defaults to 20.

client_message.description: The client's request, call notes or a feature list.

hourly_rate.description: Hourly rate. Defaults to 100 (or the language's default).

language.description: Language of the labels and currency: en (USD), pt (BRL), es or de (EUR). Defaults to en.

name: calculate_sow_pricing

preview_url.description: Opens this estimate, editable, in the TempoRevenue web calculator.

title: Calculate SOW pricing
